title: Films per director
statementMd:
For each director show their name and how many movies they made.

Expected columns: `name`, `movies`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) AS movies FROM directors d JOIN movies m ON m.director_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
